description: This file defines data structures and functions for indexing and searching Mattermost data in Elasticsearch, including posts, files, channels, and users. It includes methods for creating index names, extracting URLs, and processing highlight snippets.

methods.name: ESPostFromPost
methods.description: Creates an ESPost object from a Post, team ID, and channel type.

methods.name: ESPostFromPostForIndexing
methods.description: Converts a PostForIndexing object into an ESPost, extracting message details and URLs.

methods.name: extractURLsFromMessage
methods.description: Extracts and filters URLs from a message string, removing markdown links.

methods.name: splitFilenameWords
methods.description: Replaces hyphens and dots in filenames with spaces for better search indexing.

methods.name: ESFileFromFileInfo
methods.description: Creates an ESFile object from a FileInfo, including filename processing.

methods.name: ESFileFromFileForIndexing
methods.description: Creates an ESFile object from a FileForIndexing.

methods.name: ESChannelFromChannel
methods.description: Creates an ESChannel object from a Channel, user IDs, and team member IDs.

methods.name: ESUserFromUserAndTeams
methods.description: Creates an ESUser object from a User, team IDs, and channel IDs, including suggestion generation.

methods.name: ESUserFromUserForIndexing
methods.description: Creates an ESUser object from a UserForIndexing object.

methods.name: SearchIndexName
methods.description: Returns the Elasticsearch index pattern for a given index name, considering global prefix.

methods.name: BuildPostIndexName
methods.description: Generates a post index name based on creation date and aggregation rules.

methods.name: NumIndexWorkers
methods.description: Determines the number of Elasticsearch index worker routines based on CPU count.

methods.name: ReadFileSafely
methods.description: Reads a file safely with size limit and timeout, returning its contents.

methods.name: GetMatchesForHit
methods.description: Parses highlighted snippets to extract matched terms from message, attachments, URLs, and hashtags.
